description: This file defines extension methods for handling Azure Storage exceptions, specifically RequestFailedException, to identify different error conditions such as NotFound, PreconditionFailed, Conflict, ContainerNotFound, and BlobNotFound.

classes.name: StorageExceptionExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for RequestFailedException to identify specific Azure Storage error conditions.

methods.name: IsNotFound
methods.description: Checks if the exception indicates a 'Not Found' (404) error.

methods.name: IsPreconditionFailed
methods.description: Checks if the exception indicates a 'Precondition Failed' (412) error.

methods.name: IsConflict
methods.description: Checks if the exception indicates a 'Conflict' (409) error.

methods.name: IsContainerNotFound
methods.description: Checks if the exception indicates that a container was not found, based on status and error code.

methods.name: IsBlobNotFound
methods.description: Checks if the exception indicates that a blob was not found, based on status and error code.
